pr.title: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding

raw_findings.body: `execute(...)[0]` is nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration and blocking the upgrade.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Migration raises at runtime and the schema change never completes.
raw_findings.impact: `execute(...)[0]` is nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration and blocking the upgrade.
raw_findings.root_cause: Chaining `[0]['id']` on the query result assumes at least one row is always returned.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Capture the result set, guard for an empty result (e.g. `row = execute(...).first; category_id = row ? row['id'].to_i : 0`) before dereferencing, then fall back to uncategorized.
raw_findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category setting has no matching category row
raw_findings.trigger: Running the migration on any install where the `embed_category` site setting is unset (its default is '') or does not match an existing category name, so the SELECT returns zero rows.

raw_findings.body: `lower(host)` is compared against a non-downcased parameter, so a stored host never matches a mixed-case incoming host and embedding is incorrectly rejected.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Legitimate embed requests are denied for hosts referenced with any uppercase letters.
raw_findings.impact: `lower(host)` is compared against a non-downcased parameter, so a stored host never matches a mixed-case incoming host and embedding is incorrectly rejected.
raw_findings.root_cause: The SQL lowercases the column but the Ruby-side value is left in its original case, defeating the intended case-insensitive comparison.
raw_findings.title: record_for_host lowercases the column but not the bind value
raw_findings.trigger: A referer/embed URL whose host contains uppercase characters (e.g. `http://EvilTrout.com`).

raw_findings.body: `category_fabricator.rb` now defines `:embeddable_host` while `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` defines the category fabricators, so the file names no longer describe their contents and future edits land in the wrong file.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Maintainability/discoverability degrades; edits are applied to misleadingly named files.
raw_findings.impact: `category_fabricator.rb` now defines `:embeddable_host` while `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` defines the category fabricators, so the file names no longer describe their contents and future edits land in the wrong file.
raw_findings.root_cause: The fabricator definitions were written into files whose names describe the opposite fabricator.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Move the `:embeddable_host` fabricator into `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` and keep the category fabricators in `category_fabricator.rb`.
raw_findings.title: Category and embeddable-host fabricators placed in swapped files
raw_findings.trigger: A developer opening `category_fabricator.rb` to edit the category fabricator, or `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` to edit the embeddable-host fabricator.

raw_findings.body: `EmbeddableHost.where(...).first` returns nil and `host.destroy` raises NoMethodError producing a 500 instead of a graceful error.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled exception yields a 500 response for a missing record.
raw_findings.impact: `EmbeddableHost.where(...).first` returns nil and `host.destroy` raises NoMethodError producing a 500 instead of a graceful error.
raw_findings.root_cause: The looked-up record is dereferenced without checking for nil.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Use `find_by`/guard for nil and return a 404 or error json when the record is missing before calling `destroy`.
raw_findings.title: destroy raises NoMethodError when host id is not found
raw_findings.trigger: A DELETE request with an `id` that does not correspond to an existing EmbeddableHost (stale UI, concurrent delete, or crafted request).

raw_findings.body: `nil.sub!` raises NoMethodError before the format validation can report the blank host as invalid.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Validation raises instead of returning a validation error.
raw_findings.impact: `nil.sub!` raises NoMethodError before the format validation can report the blank host as invalid.
raw_findings.root_cause: The callback calls `sub!` directly on `self.host` without ensuring it is non-nil.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Guard the callback (e.g. `return if host.blank?`) before mutating `self.host`.
raw_findings.title: before_validation raises when host is nil
raw_findings.trigger: Validating an EmbeddableHost whose `host` attribute is nil (e.g. `EmbeddableHost.new.valid?` or a create request with no `host` param).
